I really liked Sheriam and she didn't seem to be as bad as many other Black sisters and she mustn't have been Black for long since she was Aes Sedai for twenty years.

I never suspected Sorilea or any Aiel Wise One, they are too protective of their people.

Verin acted very suspicious during the entire series but she played a great role.

I suspected Danelle back when Siuan was deposed but apparently she was Mesaana in disguise. Mazrim Taim never fooled anyone.

And I thought Lelaine or Romanda were darkfriends but I'm glad they weren't.
